inputs.text: Minimal flat vector app logo: a super-simplified chibi kitsune fox-girl head, front-facing and perfectly symmetric, huge triangular fox ears, simple happy closed eyes like two curved lines, tiny dot blush, small smile. Thick clean dark outlines, only three flat colors: indigo hair, sakura-pink ear tips, white face. Centered on a plain white background with margin. Iconic, readable at tiny sizes, professional logo design, no text, no photo, no shadows, no shading
